parts.name: Lens
parts.Basic_description: The lens is a cylindrical optical component made of glass, located at the front of the camera.
parts.Functional_description: It focuses light onto the camera sensor to capture images with clarity and precision.
parts.Movement_description: It can move slightly for zooming or focusing, either manually or automatically.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic button located on the top of the camera.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to trigger the shutter or power functions of the camera.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: Another small plastic button on the camera body.
parts.Functional_description: It may control camera modes, settings, or menu navigation.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly when pressed and returns to its resting position.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A plastic button located near the top or back of the camera.
parts.Functional_description: It could be used for video recording or playback control.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly when pressed and returns to its original position.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic button integrated into the camera interface.
parts.Functional_description: It may serve as a function or menu selection button.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly when pressed and returns to its original position.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main structural body of the camera made of aluminum alloy.
parts.Functional_description: It houses all internal components, provides structural integrity, and supports external attachments.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, rigid part that does not move during normal operation.
